description: Replace the agent's settings and return the updated entry. Known limitation: this is a FULL REPLACEMENT, not a patch - every field you omit is reset, so read the current settings with mba_get_agent_settings first and send them back with your change applied. Note also that setting rollout.enabled to false stops the AI responding on all threads; re-enabling it makes the AI respond to new threads only, not to threads that were already open.

agent_id.description: Optional - restrict the update to one agent.

ai_audience.description: ALLOWLISTED_ONLY restricts the agent to the numbers on the allowlist.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

followup.description: Following up with an inactive user.

handoff.description: Handing the conversation to a human agent.

rollout.description: Whether the agent responds at all. Disabling it stops the AI answering on every thread.

name: mba_update_agent_settings

outputSchema.description: The AI agent settings for an entity

agent_id.description: Unique identifier for this agent configuration. Use this ID to target a specific agent in update or delete operations

ai_audience.description: Controls which consumers the AI agent responds to. EVERYONE = all consumers (default), ALLOWLISTED_ONLY = only phone numbers in the allowlist. Null for non-WhatsApp entities. Known values: ALLOWLISTED_ONLY, EVERYONE.

channel.description: The channel/platform these settings apply to. Known values: email, instagram, line, messenger, sms, tiktok, unknown, webchat, whatsapp.

followup.description: Settings for following up with an inactive user. Null if not configured

enabled.description: Whether followup is enabled. true to enable, false to disable

followup_interval_in_seconds.description: The time in seconds of user inactivity before the followup message is sent. Setting to 0 will disable followup. Known values: 0, 300, 900, 1800, 3600, 7200, 28800, 86400.

message.description: The message sent to follow up with the user after inactivity

handoff.description: Settings for handing over the conversation to a human agent. Null if not configured

enabled.description: Whether handoff to a human agent is enabled. true to enable, false to disable

message.description: The message displayed to the user when a handoff to a human agent occurs

rollout.description: Rollout configuration for the AI agent, containing the enabled flag and future gradual rollout fields

enabled.description: Whether the AI agent is currently enabled. true for on, false for off

title: Update agent settings
